test_default_server_base: test the DefaultServerBase class that launches and manages an SGLang server process for integration tests
run_openai_api_env: run the openai_api_env context manager to set OpenAI API key and base URL environment variables
run_popen_launch_server: run popen_launch_server to start an SGLang model server process in a subprocess
run_kill_process_tree: run kill_process_tree to terminate an SGLang server process and its child processes
run_flush_cache: run flush_cache to send a POST request to the /flush_cache endpoint of the running server
